title: Reddit just beat its numbers. Its stock fell 20% anyway, because of Google.
excerpt: Reddit’s Q2 revenue jumped 61%, but its stock fell more than 20% on fears Google’s AI Overviews is drying up the search traffic it depends on.
content_html:
Reddit just had a blockbuster quarter. Revenue rose 61% to $805 million. Profit more than doubled. Daily users climbed 18%. Then the stock fell more than 20%. The numbers were not the problem. Google was.

Investors looked past the beat and fixed on one line from CEO Steve Huffman: search referrals had been “choppy.” Reddit’s content sits near the top of countless Google results, so a large share of its visitors arrive through search. If that pipe narrows, the growth story wobbles, however good the quarter looks.

Huffman used the moment to go on the offensive. In a letter to shareholders, he cast Reddit as the antidote to a web drowning in machine-made text. “As the internet becomes flooded with synthetic content, people are craving real human perspective,” he wrote. His sharpest line: “People don’t want a summary of Reddit; they want Reddit.”

On the earnings call, he told Engadget’s readers and investors what he thinks of AI Overviews, Google’s feature that answers queries at the top of the page. The old “10 blue links” drove real value, he said. “From where we sit, AI Overviews has yet to make a similar level of positive impact… we’re still looking for that win-win.”

The $60m question

The friction is awkward, because Google pays Reddit for the privilege. A 2024 licensing deal, reportedly worth about $60 million a year, lets Google train on and surface Reddit content. Reddit struck a similar deal with OpenAI. Now Huffman is openly questioning whether the Google arrangement still serves him.

Asked directly if Reddit might end it, he did not say no. “The range of outcomes is wide,” he said, adding that the company had to maximise value to Reddit. That echoes a July report from the Wall Street Journal, which said Reddit had discussed cutting off Google’s access to its content for AI use.

Reddit is not alone in weighing the same move. The Journal named The Economist, Reuters, Politico and USA Today among publishers rethinking their Google relationships. The bind is that being a blue link and being fed into AI Overviews come as a package. Only recently, and only in the UK, have regulators forced Google to let publishers opt out of one without losing the other.

Google’s counter

Google rejects the premise. In a blog post, search chief Liz Reid said total organic click volume to websites has stayed “relatively stable year-over-year,” and dismissed third-party studies as flawed. The trouble is the studies point the other way. A 2025 Pew analysis found AI Overviews roughly halved click-throughs to outside sites.

The two sides cannot agree on the basic facts, which is the real story. Publishers see referrals falling; Google sees them holding. What is not in dispute is the nervousness. When even a search goldmine like Reddit starts eyeing the exit, and hedging with a “video Reddit” and spoken posts, the web’s referral economy is being repriced in real time.

For now, Reddit’s data is coveted by every AI company, and its numbers are strong. The question the 20% drop asked is a harder one. It is whether strong numbers are enough when the front door to the open web, search itself, is quietly narrowing. Even Cloudflare is now trying to make the crawlers pay.

content_html_zh:
Reddit 刚刚经历了一个轰动一时的季度。 收入增长 61% 至 8.05 亿美元。 利润增加了一倍多。 每日用户增长 18%。 随后股价下跌超过20%。 数字不是问题。 谷歌是。

投资者忽略了这一点，只关注首席执行官史蒂夫·霍夫曼(Steve Huffman)的一句话：搜索推荐一直“不稳定”。 Reddit 的内容位于无数 Google 结果的顶部，因此很大一部分访问者是通过搜索到达的。 如果这个管道变窄，无论这个季度看起来多么好，增长故事都会摇摆不定。

霍夫曼利用这个机会发起进攻。 在给股东的一封信中，他将 Reddit 视为淹没在机器文本中的网络的解药。 “随着互联网上充斥着合成内容，人们渴望真正的人类视角，”他写道。 他最尖锐的一句话是：“人们想要的不是 Reddit 的摘要；他们想要的是 Reddit。”

在财报电话会议上，他告诉 Engadget 的读者和投资者他对人工智能概述的看法，这是谷歌在页面顶部回答查询的功能。 他说，旧的“10 个蓝色链接”带来了真正的价值。 “从我们的立场来看，人工智能概述尚未产生类似水平的积极影响...... 我们仍在寻求双赢。”

价值 6000 万美元的问题

这种摩擦很尴尬，因为谷歌向 Reddit 支付了这一特权。 据报道，2024 年的一项许可协议每年价值约 6000 万美元，允许 Google 训练和展示 Reddit 内容。 Reddit 与 OpenAI 达成了类似的协议。 现在，霍夫曼公开质疑谷歌的安排是否仍然对他有利。

当被直接问及 Reddit 是否会结束它时，他没有说不。 “结果的范围很广，”他说，并补充说公司必须最大限度地提高 Reddit 的价值。 这与《华尔街日报》7 月份的一篇报道相呼应，该报道称 Reddit 已讨论切断谷歌对其用于人工智能的内容的访问。

Reddit 并不是唯一一个考虑采取同样举措的人。 《华尔街日报》将《经济学人》、《路透社》、《政治》和《今日美国》列为重新考虑与 Google 关系的出版商。 绑定是作为一个蓝色链接并作为一个包输入到人工智能概述中。 直到最近，而且只有在英国，监管机构才迫使谷歌允许出版商选择退出其中一项，而不会失去另一项。

谷歌的柜台

谷歌拒绝了这个前提。 搜索主管 Liz Reid 在一篇博客文章中表示，网站的总有机点击量“同比保持相对稳定”，并认为第三方研究存在缺陷。 问题是研究指向了相反的方向。 皮尤研究中心 2025 年的一项分析发现，人工智能概览将外部网站的点击量大致减少了一半。

双方在基本事实上无法达成一致，这才是真实的情况。 出版商发现推荐量下降；谷歌认为他们持有。 没有争议的是紧张。 即使是像 Reddit 这样的搜索金矿也开始着眼于退出，并通过“视频 Reddit”和口头帖子进行对冲，网络的推荐经济正在实时重新定价。

目前，Reddit 的数据令每家人工智能公司都垂涎，而且数据强劲。 20% 的下降提出的问题是一个更难的问题。 当开放网络的前门（即搜索本身）正在悄然缩小时，问题在于强大的数字是否足够。 就连 Cloudflare 现在也试图让爬虫付费。
